cases.title: A ROTATE Copy of pit P3 placed 5 m away takes none of P3's pipes and joins no pipe end, with no 'sits on pipe ends' line
cases.plan_item: BUG-1227 Part A guard (b): copy 5 m away changes nothing (pre-review E item 3.4.6)
cases.expected: ROTATE Copy of P3 by 180 degrees about 56277.7,-25569.9 puts one new pit block at 58777.7,-25569.9 (within 1 mm) with a CE line that one pit was copied and numbered as new; its label reads P8; P3's own label still reads P3; no 'sits on pipe ends already joined' line and no 'Pit schedule cell for P3' line print; the CE log has no line giving the copy a pipe end (no from=P8 and no to=P8) and none of P3's five pipes moves to P8. The drawing file on disk is unchanged.
cases.why_not_unit: The copy relink runs when AutoCAD ends the native ROTATE command on the live drawing; the switch is read from the real settings file at start.
not_automated: DERIVED: nothing in DRV1_B1 is known to have a pipe end at 58777.7,-25569.9; if a from=P8 or to=P8 line appears, read the recorded log and look at that spot before calling it a fault. P8 is the first free number (R34so).
